params.name: language
params.description: BCP-47 language code (e.g. en, fr, de, zh, ja, es)

params.name: term
params.description: Concept term in the given language, with spaces replaced by underscores (e.g. french_toast, dog, run_away)

params.name: offset
params.description: Number of results to skip for pagination (0-100000)

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of results to return (0-1000)

params.name: grouped
params.description: When true, groups edges by relation type rather than returning a flat list.

items.docs: Returns a JSON-LD node object for the concept identified by language and term. The response includes all edges (assertions) connecting the concept to other concepts, paginated via offset and limit. The term may include underscores in place of spaces and an optional sense disambiguation suffix (e.g. /c/en/lead/n for the noun sense of "lead").

info.name: Look up a sense-disambiguated concept node

params.name: language
params.description: BCP-47 language code (e.g. en, fr, de, zh, ja, es)

params.name: term
params.description: Concept term in the given language, with spaces replaced by underscores (e.g. french_toast, dog, run_away)

params.name: sense
params.description: Part-of-speech tag or sense identifier (e.g. n, v, a, r)

params.name: offset
params.description: Number of results to skip for pagination (0-100000)

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of results to return (0-1000)

items.docs: Returns a JSON-LD node object for a specific word sense of the concept. The sense component is a part-of-speech tag (n, v, a, r) or a more specific sense identifier. For example, /c/en/lead/n returns the noun sense of "lead" while /c/en/lead/v returns the verb sense.
